title: Dragon on Zodiac Wheel
description: A vibrant green dragon wearing a red scarf sits atop a large cracked stone zodiac wheel, holding a glowing staff. Below, a dark silhouetted figure kneels with hands raised toward the dragon beside an ornate chest, set against a detailed background with banners, smoke, and colorful light trails.
prompt: A vibrant green dragon with a red scarf sits on a large cracked stone zodiac wheel covered in symbols, holding a glowing staff that emits smoke, a dark silhouetted human figure kneels below with hands raised in awe next to an ornate chest, background shows banners, floating circles, and colorful light trails in the sky, detailed fantasy illustration style, whimsical and mystical atmosphere
